Dataset measurements

Measurements you can inspect

Compare organoid versions

448 of 606 prototype images (73.9%) fall below the provisional brightness threshold of 20/255. This is an illumination-screen result; manual review is needed to establish agreement. Passing brightness alone does not establish acceptable focus.

The 20 archival 2024 scenes have original and processed versions, with a median paired brightness change of +57.6/255. Brightness changes describe processing effects; they do not establish improved focus or biological health.

Usage instructions

Image-quality workflow

Browse captures

Select beads or organoids, filter by source year or date, and open a capture to inspect its metadata and preview. Use the paired viewer to compare original and processed organoid images.

Review quality

Open the collection’s review screen. Label technical visibility as Good, Bad or Unsure. Confirm a matched reference only when the acquisition conditions are suitable, then export the review JSON.

Measure new images

Choose PNG or JPEG files in Pick specific captures, enter their source metadata, and download the trial CSV. Selected files and results remain in this browser session; export before leaving.

A brightness result alone is not a focus or biological-health assessment. Inspect original-resolution images when fine detail matters. Illumination thresholds are configured screening criteria, not validated universal quality limits.
